results.name: decimal area, fractional rooms and cents reach the selected workspace and project
negative values and fractions of a cent do not submit
uncertain response freezes inputs and replays the exact request and identifiers
malformed success, wrong workspace and server failure retain the original attempt
terminal validation allows correction and uses a fresh intent
a double submit during a delayed response sends one command
refresh failure after confirmed persistence cannot replay the completed command
an unconfirmed create cannot be retargeted to another workspace
overview distinguishes explicit scalar area zero from unknown without certifying an unconfirmed unit price
